event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Chip rout, rotation into cyclicals.
Marvell's Lumentum deal report (-12.72%) plus Broadcom's $63B AI-chip financing headline crushed semis, sending SOXX -3.79% and QQQ -1.36%, while October ISM Manufacturing printed 55.5 vs 54.6 fc and construction spending -1.9% vs +0.4% fc. Money left AI hardware and landed in XLY +2.41%, XLF +1.86%, XLP +1.58%.

INDICES — VIX 21.1, above its 17.3 20-day MA.
DIA +0.43%, IWM -0.07%, SPY -0.48%, QQQ -1.36%, SOXX -3.79%. Small > large by 1.33pp (IJR +0.85%) — a broad-tape up day masked by mega-cap tech. Crude was the outlier: USO -7.08% against silver +2.17% and gold +1.65%. SPY sits 2.93% lower over 20d, below trend.

VOLUME & BREADTH — QQQ 1.4x, XLE 1.1x.
QQQ volume 1.4x with price -1.36% = distribution; XLE 1.1x with -3.96% = mild distribution. IJR 1.7x and RSP 1.6x on up days = genuine accumulation beneath the surface. Breadth: 345/157 adv/dec (69% up), 67% above 50-DMA, up/down volume 1.10, 91 new 60d highs vs 38 lows — participation confirms a broad, not narrow, tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLY Discretionary +2.41%, XLF Financials +1.86%, XLP Staples +1.58%, XLI Industrials +1.38%, XLRE Real Estate +1.09%, XLU Utilities +0.55%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLB Materials +0.00%, XLV Healthcare -0.15%, XLK Technology -2.95%, XLE Energy -3.96%.
Top industries: MSOS +6.60%, TAN +4.65%; bottom: OIH -5.48%, USO -7.08%. Flows: XLF +$781mm (86p) and XLI +$529mm (85p) inflow, XLE -$82mm and XLU -$47mm outflow — leaders attracting money, confirming real rotation. Money-in: financials and discretionary; money-out: energy and tech. Label: high-to-low rotation, broadening participation.

POSITIONING — Protection bid, dispersion wide.
SPY PCR 1.28 and IWM 2.81 signal heavy put demand; QQQ IV 39.5% and skew +9.6% price fear. VIX 21.1 vs 17.3 20-day MA. VIXEQ 44.7 vs VIX 21.1 — wide gap = single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape, not correlated macro.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil and tech transmitting together.
USO -7.08% (20d still +8.95%) hit energy while XLE's -3.96% offset tax on airlines (JETS +4.16%); the AI-chip financing story is the other chain, crushing MRVL/INTC/ORCL and lifting silver +2.17%. Next FOMC Dec 9; CME FedWatch hold 0.0%/cut 0.0%/hike 100.0%, Polymarket hike 72% vs 26% no-change (-6pp in 5d).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50.9, Neutral.
Movers: MRVL -12.72% (Lumentum deal report), INTC -8.80% (Broadcom $63B AI-chip financing), ORCL -8.76% (filed to raise $20B, $10B common). Momentum worst: XLK -13.29% 20d, XLE 5.99% positive; vol spikes TAN 2.7x +4.65% (accumulation) and MRVL 2.7x -12.72% (distribution). Watch tomorrow: USO -7.08% (oil vol), SLV +2.17% with 50.7% IV (silver squeeze risk), XLV -0.15% relative lag against 67% breadth.
